- Home: select Wi-Fi or Bluetooth and a "+" appears on the other radio; tap it to pair them into one tile (no more long press)
- Wardriving is back with the pair: drone detector (Remote ID), hidden camera detector and wardriving with WiGLE upload
- Wardriving: new look, a compact list, an icon per Wi-Fi protection (open, OWE, WEP, WPA, WPA2, WPA2/3, WPA3, EAP), the device icon for identified Bluetooth devices and the kind of Bluetooth address (public, static, resolvable, anonymous)
- Wardriving: export the whole run as a WiGLE CSV file next to the upload button
- Wardriving: import and export the exclusion list (MAC addresses and OUIs); excluded networks stay in the list, faded and marked in red, but are never recorded
- SDR: Meshtastic can listen on any frequency (400 to 1000 MHz) with any preset
- Settings: the debug log is now a single tile with share, save and clear
